remarks: Fifth floor one bedroom sleeping 6 suite available for Fractional Ownership. Tamarack ownership gives you 10-11 weeks per year, or about 1 week per month on a rotating basis so in a 5-6 year cycle you get all weeks. Ownership allows you to use your week, rent your week, or a combination of both. Amenities include year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, hot tubs, sauna, fitness center, private locker room, private owner lounge, and valet parking. Underground parking is available when you are lodging overnight.
